description:
We are looking for an IT Business Analyst to take ownership of our SAP FI/CO landscape and play a key role in developing Finance processes across our international operations.

Professional Competencies

  • 5+ years of professional experience with SAP FI/CO;
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP ECC 6.0 EHP7; S/4HANA experience is a strong advantage;
  • Solid knowledge of FI/CO processes and customizing, including GL, AP/AR, Asset Accounting, Cost Centers, Internal Orders, Profit Centers, Product Costing and CO-PA;
  • Experience leading or contributing to SAP implementation projects and ECC-to-S/4HANA transitions;
  • Experience with SAP reporting, financial analyses and KPIs;
  • Knowledge of SD, MM, PP, WM and QM is a plus;
  • Good knowledge of English; German is a plus;
  • Willingness to travel.

Social Competencies

  • Strong analytical and structured approach;
  • Excellent communication skills;
  • Strong problem-solving and organizational skills;
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across different teams, functions and cultures;
  • Resilient, customer-focused and quality-oriented mindset;

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of the SAP FI/CO solution landscape;
  • Lead and support SAP FI/CO projects, working closely with internal teams and external partners;
  • Design, implement and maintain FI/CO customizing according to business requirements;
  • Contribute to the ECC 6.0 to S/4HANA transformation for Finance;
  • Manage requirements, specifications, testing, releases, documentation and 2nd/3rd-level support;
  • Develop financial reports, analyses and KPIs that support business decisions;
  • Work closely with Finance, Tax, Treasury, Shared Services and other SAP teams;
  • Coordinate with implementation partners, tax advisors, e-invoicing providers and auditors;
  • Ensure smooth integration between FI/CO and other SAP modules such as MM, SD, PP, WM and QM.
